LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 7.1.1 PRESENTATION SKILLS- DEBATE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.1: Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation Skills- Debate
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation Skills- Debate, part of Strand 7 in Grade 9 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How can we be more persuasive during a debate? 2. Why is first aid important?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to an online or recorded public presentation on the theme,

2. discuss the qualities of an effective public speaker from the presentation,

3. use adverbs to describe the actions of the presenters from the recording,

4. list the adverbs on manila paper for display,

5. work with peers to discuss the qualities of an effective debater,

6. collaborate with peer and allocate roles to hold a debating session on a topic of choice,

7. peer review each other’s performance,

8. discuss with peers some of the best debaters in various fields. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to an online or recorded public presentation on the theme,
2. discuss the qualities of an effective public speaker from the presentation,
3. use adverbs to describe the actions of the presenters from the recording,
4. list the adverbs on manila paper for display,
5. work with peers to discuss the qualities of an effective debater,
6. collaborate with peer and allocate roles to hold a debating session on a topic of choice,
7. peer review each other’s performance,
8. discuss with peers some of the best debaters in various fields. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 7.1.1 Presentation Skills- Debate together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration. This is enhanced as the learner collaborates with peers and allocates roles to hold a

debating session on a topic of choice.

• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to an online or recorded

public presentation on the theme.

Values:
• Love: It is enhanced as the learner respects others when peer reviewing their performance.

• Respect: It is promoted as the learner accommodates diverse opinions when discussing some of the best debaters in

various fields.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Safety and Security is enhanced as the learner listens to an online or recorded public presentation on the theme – First Aid.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate vocabulary learnt on first aid to their learning of safety measures in Integrated Science.
